cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I book the trip, who can still cancel it? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The committee approved it. Please book before we lose the coach.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Whose objection would stop you paying the deposit?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer's. But she's away, and her deputy has the bank login.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can the deputy release it alone, or does she still need the treasurer's permission?
